title: Density-switch regressions: touch interaction and chart overflow on mobile browsers
creator: Eleanor Shaw
description:
Background:
After the density tokens rollout (density v2), QA flagged a set of intermittent regressions on mobile browsers (iOS Safari 17.x, Android Firefox ESR and latest Chrome for comparison). Issues surfaced in the compact-density table and chart components when users interact via touch gestures. This ticket is a design-led QA triage: reproduce, prioritize, and define short-term patches vs longer-term token/profile changes.

Scope:
- Buttons: hit area shrinkage in compact density at <=420px leading to missed taps and focus flicker.
- Tables: sticky header misalignment during momentum scroll bounce and cell clipping when virtualized row heights collapse.
- Charts: legend overflow + tooltip tap latency on iOS Safari leading to lost taps and delayed tooltips; horizontal pan gesture conflict with container swipe.
- Tokens: density token scale mismatch between chart canvas CSS variables and component padding tokens causing visual drift.

Acceptance criteria:
- Repro steps documented and failing screenshots/video captured for each issue and browser/device combo.
- Prioritized list of fixes with clear owner (design, front-end, or infra) and estimate.
- Hotfixes defined that are safe for minor release (console-2026.03) and a roadmap item for token scaling rewrite.

Design constraints and non-goals:
- Avoid deep layout rework for v1 hotfix; prefer CSS containment, hit-area padding via pseudo-elements, and touch-action tuning.
- Accessibility: ensure 44x44px minimum tappable targets where possible without breaking compact token spec; document any deviations for PM approval.
test_steps: Prepare devices: iPhone 14 (iOS 17.2 Safari), iPhone SE (iOS 16.x), Pixel 6 (Android 13 Firefox Nightly), Emulator: Android 12 Firefox ESR
Open dashboard pages with heavy tables and charts at 360px, 390px, 420px breakpoints; record 60s interactions (scroll, tap legend, tap data point, two-finger gestures)
Run accessibility tap-size audit with Axe mobile and manual 2.5mm guide for hit areas
Capture network and console logs; annotate timeline where tap was missed vs handled
Re-run after applying '-webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch' and 'touch-action: pan-y' adjustments to container
bugs: BUG-1207: Table sticky header jumps 6-8px after momentum scroll on iOS Safari when density=compact
BUG-1212: Button secondary-small hit area reduces below 36x36 on certain token combinations (dark theme + compact) causing missed taps
BUG-1218: Chart legend wraps and becomes non-interactive on first tap in Firefox Android; subsequent taps work
BUG-1224: Tooltip open latency >300ms on iOS Safari for chart points when requestAnimationFrame queue is busy
BUG-1230: Horizontal pan on nested scroll container conflicts with carousel gesture, disabling chart pan intermittently
notes: Initial repros concentrated on medium-to-high data density dashboards (20+ rows visible). Mobile Safari is most sensitive due to double-buffered canvas + CSS variable sync. Design team validated that increasing pseudo-element hit padding by 6px reduces missed taps in prototype without changing layout; recommended as hotfix. Long-term solution: align density token scaling algorithm between CSS runtime and canvas render layer (requires infra coordination).
comments: 2026-03-03 Eleanor Shaw: Filed after pairing session with QA. Attached first-pass video of sticky header jump on iPhone SE. Repro rate ~70% on SE, ~30% on iPhone 14.
2026-03-04 Mira Patel: Did manual verification on Pixel 6; observed legend tap issue on Firefox Android. Added screenshots to drive link.

2026-03-06 Jonah Rivera (FE): Proposed CSS hotfixes: add '-webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch' to table wrapper, use ::after pseudo-element to extend button hit area, and set 'touch-action: manipulation' on chart canvas container. Will open PR for review.

2026-03-08 PM review (Aisha Khan): Approved hotfix approach for console-2026.03 if accessibility audit passes. Asked to document deviation where tap targets are adjusted below spec and get UX lead sign-off.
2026-03-10 Design review (E. Shaw): Confirmed visual QA checklist for hotfix. Flagged token-scale rewrite as roadmap item for Q2 (design + infra + applied-ml collaboration).

2026-03-12 QA (Liam O'Connor): Tested PR #1317 on devices; table sticky header reproduction dropped to 2/20 interactions on iPhone SE. Legend tap issue persists intermittently in Firefox ESR; filed follow-up ENG ticket ENG-9521 for pointer-event race condition investigation.
2026-03-14 Mira Patel: Updated ticket with final prioritization. Hotfix PR merged to release branch; rollout scheduled in canary for 2026-03-15. Adding post-release monitoring checklist.
